book.name: 1 KOLINITA
book.title: Kolinita wali Leta Houwan Pol wana Leleli

content: No pagan nuku ahe, ni ola nau Keliso wana pagan ya ahe.
Pol I Baaba Kaun ana Pahapahabobu kaiwena
Ya tobalagimiu kaiwena sauga gegewena ku nuwahikagau ge panpankiti toto ya ahe ge abwe ya pankitemiu ku toulil bubun.
Yaa nuwau nuku atena te bolau gegewel kaunuliya heiya Keliso, yowau kaunuliya heiya lagoliyau, ge Keliso kaununa heiya Yehoba.

Nige wala pagan i oola tage bolau kaliko nihi ahe ge kaunuliya nihi pahabobu, inoke ebo tau etega kaununa ni pahabobu ge ebo ni awanun o ebo Yehoba wana baaba ni baubaunan, he kaununa, iya Keliso, i papuluwawi-an to.

Yaa ebo yova etega kaununa nige ni papahabobu ni oola yowau wali pagan, ge ebo toekelesiya mataliyaa ni awanun o ebo Yehoba wana baaba ni baubaunan, he kaununa, heiya lagona, i papuluwawi-an to. Ebo kaununa nige ni papahabobu, he iya i ola yowau bolo kaunuliya hi kol yoho.
Inoke ebo yova etega nige nuwana kaununa ni pahabobu, he gegewena ni tomwa yoho ya! Yaa ana kite i pulupuluwawi ebo yova kaununa ni tomwa yoho o ebo ni kol, inoke i waisi te kaununa ni pahabobu.

Nige bosowaina tau kaununa ni pahabobu, kaiwena Yehoba tau i ginol totona kanukanununa elana, ge Yehoba wana wasawasa i pamasal. Yaa yova kaununa ni pahabobu, kaiwena iya tau wana wasawasa ni pamasal.
Ya ba ola o, kaiwena Yehoba nige tau i giginolem yova eliyana, yaa yova i ginolem tau elana.
I ola al, nige tage Yehoba tau i ginol yova kaiwena, yaa yova i ginol tau kaiwena.
Inoke heiya te kaiwena yova kaununa ni pahabobu inoke ni pankitela iya iyoho i minaa lagona wana logugui eliyana. I ola al, aneloseyau nihi kite yova lagona i awatauwan.
Yaa wala mina Babala Keliso eliyana, nige totomaha i gagan tau ge yova elal. Yova iya tau ana tolabe ge tau iya yova ana tolabe.
Kaiwena valila Yehoba yova i ginolem tau elana, ge i ola al sauga ya tau i masalem yova elana. Yaa Yehoba iya bugul gegewena wali masal puna.
Totomiu ga ku nuwatu. I waisi ya ebo yowau nige kaunuliya nihi papahabobu ge nihi awanun toekelesiya mataliyaa?
Kila gamagalau wala pagan i pankitela ebo tau kaununa yayapona, he i papapuluwawi.
Yaa ebo yova kaununa i yapu, he ana awa i waisa, kaiwena Yehoba i pek kokowana ana habobu. He i ola al i waisa te kaunuliya nihi pahabobu awanun kaiwena.
Ebo etega nuwatu ya ni awa nanakan, he anana na lahe na ba, “Ama alomeyau Yehoba wana ekelesiya labi tomaha ge tomaha, wama tapwalolo ana kamwasa i ola ya to.”
Babala wana Aanan

Sauga ya nuwau na panpankiti eliyamiu bugul etega kaiwena. He bugul ya bana nige bosowaina na tobalagimiu, kaiwena sauga ebo ku nogogo, wami tapwalolo nige ana waisi etega i gagan, yaa ana nak ya te i gan.
Houwan, wasamiu ya hago tage sauga ebo ku nogogo, inoke ekelesiya ana boda ku waliwali-an. Ge wasa o kekeisi ya awa tutunahoti.
He tunahot ami getoga ni gan wami boda gamwanaa, inoke eliyana bosowaina ta atena henalau gamwamiwa pagan toto Yehoba i yaliyaya-an hi toulil.
Yaa sauga ku nogogo ge ku anan toyawa, he tage Babala wana aanan nuku ginol.
Yaa toto komiu ku giginol nige Babala wana aanan ana pagan i oola,

kaiwena komiu maisena ge maisena ku patotoya totomiu amiu ku an, nige ku matamatan alomiyau kaiweliya. Inoke enuna tinemiu i kiya, yaa enuna galegalebomiu ya, ge enuna ku imwim nabi, yaa enuna ku kala hot.

Age nige wami limi i gagan ge eliyana nuku anan ge nuku imwim? Yehoba wana ekelesiya nige kekeisi ku aawatauwan! Alomiyau bolo nige aliya waiwaisana ku papapuluwawi-agil! Ga na ba ola eliyamiu? Age na tobalagimiu? Nigeya hot!
He toto ya aheya Babala elana ge valila ya wasaan eliyamiu i ola hiwe. Babala Yeisu, bulin o Yudasa i wasaan, beleid i ahe,
i ba mulolu Yehoba elana ge i pigebagebal-an, inoke i ba, “Toto ya iya tuwau, komiu kaiwemiu. Nuku ginol hikahikani o abanuwahikan.”
I ola al, aanan enaa oine ana kom i ahe, inoke i ba, “Oine ya, iya bateli vavaluna kaiwena, bateli o saliyau elana ni masala. Sauga ebo nuku im, nuku ginol o abanuwahikan.”
Inoke sauga toto ebo beleid ya nuku an ge oine ya nuku im, he i ola Babala wana yaomal ku wasaan to, ana siga ni sikalim.
Inoke i ola hiwe: ebo etega Babala wana beleid ge wana oine ni an ge ni im bwabwage, ge nige henapona ni giginol, he iya Babala tuwana ge saliyana i awatautau-an inoke lahena ni pwawa.
Inoke gamagal maisena ge maisena totona ni kite hilihili-an ga, mulaa abwe beleid ni an ge oine ni im.
Kaiwena ebo beleid ni an ge oine ni im ge nige Babala tuwana ge wana yaomal ali sapu ni nunuwatu-an, he totona ana lahi i ginol.
Heiya te kaiwena ami boda gamwanaa hi gewi hi kasiyebwa ge tuwaliya i pweyata, ge enuna iyaka hi aliga.
Yaa binimala totola ta kite hilihili-agila, he Yehoba wana lahi o nige ta pwapwawa.
Yaa sauga Yehoba i lahela, he i pahenapola to, inoke bahi avalau ge bolo nige toabulilek i oola lahi mihomihotina ta pwapwawa toyawe.
Taliwau ge nuwau, sauga ebo nuku nogogo Babala wana aanan kaiwena ge nuku anan toyawa, nuku matamatan alomiyau kaiweliya.

Toto ebo ni galebu, ni anan ga totona wana limiya mulaa abwe ni nem, inoke sauga nuku nogogo pamaisena, bahi Yehoba wana lahi nuku pwapwawa. Sauga ebo na nowa, abwe bugul enuna al kaiweliya na ba pasapu eliyamiu.

footnotes.text: Kila Babala wana aanan ta ginol mwaumwau-an, yaa ana awa i ola toekelesiya houhouwel wali nogogo ananina gamwanaa te beleid hi an ge oine hi im sakalameni kaiwena.
